title: Bit fields are packed least-significant bit first under bddo:LSBFirst
description: a (3 bits, 4) takes the low three bits of the first byte and b (5 bits, 22) the five above them: 10110 100 = B4. c (12 bits, 0xABC) continues in the same order, its low eight bits BC in the next byte and its high four, A, in the low nibble of the third; d (4 bits, 5) takes the nibble above: 5A.
